acceptance: Loading: in a fresh Claude Code session in BenchBox, benchbox-site and Oxbow, /memory lists the project AGENTS.md; in omp and Codex the global file shows no SHARED/ path.

Deployment: tools/skill-sync check and verify pass against ~/.skill-sync-deployment/skill-sync.conf; scripts/routing_sync.py check reports no drift for the catalog, the global store and the BenchBox mirror; ~/.agents/AGENTS.md equals deployment/global/AGENTS.md on main.

Regression sweep: every line deleted or reworded between catalog commits e04b1a7 and the deployed pin, in every non-vendored skill, is accounted for as moved, still stated by a named owner, or intentionally dropped with a reason; any lost rule is restored. Safety and authorization rules (commit, push, merge, arming, review pinning, trust of tool output, identity) are checked first.
Independent review: a reviewer from a non-Claude model family reviews that same diff and the global instruction file, and each finding has a recorded disposition.

Behaviour: one recorded task per changed workflow runs end to end under the new text without a wrong step: a todo take/finish loop including a deferral, a todo batch landing and final verification, a code review-and-fix request, a PR backlog clearance in a repository that names its own merge command, a session takeover, and a Substack dry-run publish.
The two disputed model identifiers in shared-agent-execution/references/external-harnesses.md (claude-fable-5-1 for pi and jcode) are confirmed against the installed harnesses or corrected.
BenchBox .claude/skills is pinned to the same catalog commit as the global deployment and its instruction audit and skill-integrity check pass.

description: A cleanup of the agent instruction files and catalog skills merged and deployed on 2026-11-15 (skill-sync-skills #123, #127, #129 and the pin changes #126, #128; BenchBox #4224; benchbox-site #155; Oxbow #15; textcharts #15; the global instruction file copied from deployment/global/AGENTS.md). It was verified by tests, scans and file comparison only. No live agent session exercised the changed text, and no model outside the Claude family reviewed it. A BenchBox pre-publication review of the mirrored skills then found three real regressions the catalog checks had passed (two dropped safeguards in todo/references/batch.md, one ungated merge step in code/references/pr-backlog.md), so more may remain in the roughly 400 deleted and 650 reworded lines. This item confirms the change behaves as intended and finds anything else that was lost.
